binaryRevisionAttestation: Coordinator reports target/debug/dotrepo built from the evaluated core; this packet binds its bytes, not a reproducible-build proof.
goldIsolation: The source-gold curator receives no extraction outputs; all source gold remains immutable.

scoringMethod.acceptedTuple: Compare command, working_directory, scope, component and prerequisite list with each frozen alternative after selection. Exact tuple match supports applicable acceptance. Otherwise retain accepted-unresolved-requires-source-adjudication; unlisted or paraphrased alternatives are not automatically wrong.
scoringMethod.candidateRecovery: Retain raw repo.test, test_context and every test_candidates item. A structurally complete candidate has matching context.command, directory, scope, explicit prerequisite list, source and component iff component scope; this does not establish applicability or consumer acceptance.
scoringMethod.executionBoundary: Only our Git inspection, import and public export binaries run. No upstream command, bootstrap, build, test, network request, model call, execution-success or consumer-benefit observation.
scoringMethod.importFailure: Retain failed import/export receipts and absent profiles. Missing selection against supported source gold remains a supported miss, with infrastructure failure separately visible.
scoringMethod.originalRustResults: Reuse immutable Rust consumer observations and dispositions; do not rerun or rewrite its packet.
scoringMethod.requiredAbstentionMissingSelection: correct-abstention against frozen source-gold; no fallback execution is observed.
scoringMethod.scopeAggregation: Report all assigned remaining tasks by slice/scope and combine with the immutable six-task Rust report. Full observation coverage does not imply full source-gold resolution or a passed qualification gate.
scoringMethod.selection: Reference own_projects.select_profile_instruction called with identity, actual exported profile bytes, test purpose and task scope/component only; no gold command/prerequisite filtering or repairs.
scoringMethod.sourceMaterialization: Only frozen sources/ files are copied, byte-identically, to new temporary repository roots. This is not a full checkout and absence of unretained files limits extraction completeness.
scoringMethod.supportedMissingSelection: supported-miss regardless of missing record assessment or upstream fallback availability; source gold establishes an instruction exists.
scoringMethod.timestampLimit: CLI import uses its actual timestamp; a replay may have different record timestamps. Export timestamps are fixed to this execution freeze.
scoringMethod.unresolvedGold: unresolved-gold; retained in full task denominator and separate unresolved count, never scored as correct abstention or error.
